title: The Night Market Business
topic: ชีวิตนักศึกษา/ธุรกิจ
lines: When Nam was in Grade 11, her family's small shop was losing money.
Instead of complaining, Nam decided to help. Every Friday and Saturday
night, she sold handmade bracelets at a night market near her home. At
first, **she** sold only three or four a night, and she almost gave up.
Then she noticed something. Tourists did not just want pretty bracelets;
**they** wanted a story. So Nam started writing a small card for each one,
explaining the meaning of the colors and the name of the village where
the beads were made. Her sales went up quickly. Within six months, she was
selling over fifty bracelets every weekend, and she had to ask two friends
to help **her**. Nam used part of the money to pay for her English lessons,
because many of her customers came from abroad. Now Nam is a first-year
business student. "The market taught me more than any textbook," she says.
"**It** showed me that people buy feelings, not just products."
